To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed an approach to knowledge acquisition via dialogue and we have formalized the approach within NML3.

(1) NML3 is suitable for representing an agent's knowledge; (2) a formalization of dialogue within NML3 is possible; (3) a formalization, within NML3, of a model of knowledge exchange via dialogue is possible.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a formal analysis of knowledge acquisition/ learning via cooperative dialogue.
the development of a formal model of cooperative dialogue for knowledge acquisition and learning.
the development of a formal theory for the acquisition of knowledge via cooperative dialogue.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the formalization presented in this paper, is a formalization of the basic elements of a model for knowledge acquisition via cooperative dialogue.
the formalization of dialogue in NML3 is a first attempt at a formal model for the acquisition of knowledge through dialogue.
we have developed a model of knowledge and reasoning that is suitable for the purpose of knowledge acquisition/ learning via cooperative dialogue.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a formal model of a cooperative dialogue process in which an agent learns from other agents.
we have developed a formal model of knowledge acquisition, via cooperative dialogue, in a logic-based setting.
we have developed a formal model of a dialogue-based knowledge acquisition/learning system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a formal model of cooperative dialogue is feasible.
the formalization of dialogue within NML3 provides a formal framework for knowledge acquisition via dialogue.
the formalization of dialogue and reasoning within NML3 provides a basis for a more formal model of knowledge acquisition and learning via cooperative dialogue.
